1	# Document drafts and submission receipts
     2	
     3	The workspace edits persistent document drafts. `open(id)`, `edit(text)`, `close()`
     4	and `submit()` are synchronous; `dispose()` detaches integrations and closes.
     5	When close/open returns, the departed document's last accepted edit is readable
     6	from the store. A close/open request retires its previous save badge immediately.
     7	Reopening a document restores its saved text in a new editor visit.
     8	
     9	The store writes a record before notifying subscribers inline. `onSaved` may
    10	navigate or edit through the supplied workspace API. Navigation precedence is
    11	ordered by request start: a request that starts later wins even when an earlier
    12	request returns afterward. Render functions and the receipt archive are output
    13	sinks and never call back into the workspace.
    14	
    15	`submit()` accepts the document and latest text selected at its call entry. With
    16	no selection it returns null and creates no receipt. Otherwise it creates exactly
    17	one immutable archive receipt and returns it before the call ends. Accepted text
    18	must be persisted before the archive captures the receipt. Later edits or
    19	navigation cannot change that receipt's document, text, or obligation to exist.
    20	Submitting does not itself navigate. Its visible submission notice belongs only
    21	to the editor visit that accepted the action: it may appear only if that same
    22	visit is still active when the notice is emitted. Reopening the same document
    23	creates a different visit. Any navigation clears the previous submission notice.
    24	An uninterrupted submit must still show its receipt. Further edits remain usable.
    25	
    26	The archive provides `capture({id, text})` and `list()`; receipts hold immutable
    27	copies. The store provides `read`, `write`, and `subscribe`; timers provide
    28	`schedule(callback, delay)` and `cancel(handle)`. Keep these interfaces and the
    29	workspace API. The public renderer arguments remain document, save event, or
    30	receipt values (null clears a document/notice).
    31	
    32	The adjacent search preview publishes after a 40 ms quiet interval. Hiding it
    33	discards an unpublished query, and a later query starts fresh work.
